No additional C++ poses are needed or run; original artifacts are preserved.

The replay prefix guard assumes the Python executable is unquoted; an interpreter path containing spaces would need a structured argv/quoting-aware guard for future Windows reuse. metadata_and_method_limits.issue: Error versus effect and independent physical truth
metadata_and_method_limits.detail: Shared donor-relative preparation, free remapped markers, a common IK solver and fixed empirical spheres provide repeatable construction/reference observations. These do not independently measure prosthetic hardware ground position or isolate anatomy/gait or total preparation error.
